'''Jhensrus''' was a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] frontier [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. The inhabitants of the planet were often confronted by the native creatures, hence a population of fighters and survivors was shaped.
